parameters.query:
SELECT d.id, d.content, d.variant_label, d.status,
       d.moderation_flags, d.news_id, d.job_id,
       d.created_at, d.reviewed_at,
       n.title AS news_title, n.source_name
FROM drafts d
LEFT JOIN news_pool n ON d.news_id = n.id
WHERE d.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
LIMIT 60;
